name: Nightmare Shard
summary: In the Wailing Caverns, a glowing shard bears a taint Falla Sagewind cannot ignore. She binds its pure, disturbed essence of the Emerald Dream into the Nightmare Shard and sends it to senior druids for a warning kept from others.

sections.title: A Corrupted Vision
sections.body: Deep in the Wailing Caverns, Falla Sagewind examines a mysterious glowing shard and finds its energy darker than she expected. It reflects an unnatural affliction in the Emerald Dream, like a waking nightmare. Falla binds this tainted essence into the Nightmare Shard and orders it carried without delay to elder leaders of the Cenarion Circle.

sections.title: Hushed Omens
sections.body: When the Nightmare Shard reaches Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise or Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus, each looks into its depths with dismay. The vision unsettles them and confirms their quiet suspicions that something has gone terribly wrong within the Dream. Fearing panic among the public, the druids take the shard and warn the courier to speak no further of what they saw.

faq.answer: Falla Sagewind entrusts the Nightmare Shard to a courier after examining a glowing fragment brought from the Wailing Caverns. It holds the pure, disturbed essence of the Emerald Dream, with a dark, corruptive vision instead of peaceful nature energies.

aliases: where does the shard come from
faq.answer: Falla Sagewind gives the Nightmare Shard to a courier after examining a glowing fragment brought from the Wailing Caverns. She recognizes its corruption and charges the courier to carry it directly to senior druids for study.

faq.q: Why are the druid leaders so alarmed by it?
aliases: why does mathrengyl hide the shard
faq.answer: Looking into the shard, Hamuul Runetotem and Mathrengyl Bearwalker see a nightmare twisting the Emerald Dream. Fearing danger and public panic, they silence further discussion and keep the matter among senior members of the Cenarion Circle.

faq.q: Where does the shard need to be delivered?
aliases: who do i bring the shard to
faq.answer: Horde adventurers are instructed to carry the shard to Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. Alliance travelers carry it to Mathrengyl Bearwalker within the Cenarion Circle in Darnassus.

angles.text: For druids, the shard reveals that the Emerald Dream is no longer untouched by corruption. It confirms their concerns over Naralex's fate in the Wailing Caverns.
For Horde travelers, the shard brings grave news to Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, where Hamuul Runetotem works to anchor the tauren's place in the wider Cenarion brotherhood.
